Module ingsw.myshelfie
Package it.polimi.myshelfie.model

Class ModelImpl

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.myshelfie.utils.Observable<ModelEvent,ModelView>
it.polimi.myshelfie.model.ModelImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
Model
public class ModelImpl extends Observable<ModelEvent,ModelView> implements Model
Represents the available lobbies that can be joined. It contains a list with all the lobbies created that can be modified by the addLobby(String) and removeLobby(String) methods.
